(actor no_else
  (interface (input request) (input allow) (input datain (width 3)) (input other (width 3)) (output seen (width 3)) (output done))
  (proc choose (params (c (width 1))) (cond (c (set seen datain))))
  
  (transaction main (on request) (call choose allow) (complete done)))
